title: A1: with only the assistant's own project, a request creates a project, starts work and reports a link
description: An account with one computer and no project but the assistant's own says “帮我做一个记家庭开销的小网页”. The assistant creates a project itself (policy auto), starts a helper there with a full brief, answers without jargon, and once the helper is done reports the result with a link the person can open. Guards principle 5: the assistant is complete even when the person has nothing else.
preconditions: Scratch stack on a copy of the dev database (scripts/scratch-stack.sh); the server includes WP-S1, WP-S2, WP-S3, WP-W and WP-P.
The machine running the eval has a native Claude (or Codex) login the scratch worker can use.

steps.value: fresh account pa-eval-fresh, its own worker, the assistant set up on it

assertions.expected: A1: only the assistant's project before; created one project; started work there; replies without banned words; reported the result with a link — all PASS

cleanup: scripts/scratch-stack.sh down pa-eval (the runner does this unless --keep)
